name: Docusign
description: Simplify contract management with intelligent automation powered by Docusign. Go beyond simple execution to make complex agreement workflows effortless. Use natural language to connect with your agreement data, instantly surface insights like renewal dates and key obligations, and create automated workflows that keep your business moving faster and with less friction.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Docusign to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Docusign to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.docusign.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Docusign MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Docusign lists 20 MCP tools, including getUserInfo, getAllAgreements, getAgreementDetails, getWorkflowTriggerRequirements, getWorkflowsList, triggerWorkflow, getWorkflowInstancesList, getWorkflowInstance, pauseNewWorkflowInstances, resumeWorkflow, cancelWorkflowInstance, and getEnvelopes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Docusign?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Docusign in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Docusign requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Docusign is developed by Docusign. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
